blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-security-1 (SQL injection through the search term) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.evidence:
const sql = "SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE name LIKE '%" + term + "%' ORDER BY name LIMIT 50";
return query<UserRow>(sql);
findings.recommendation: CWE-89. Any caller holding the `support` role sends `GET /users/search?q=x' UNION SELECT ...--` (src/server.ts:13-18 only trims and checks the length, 2 to 100 characters) and the term is concatenated into the SQL text, so they read any table of the database and, since the query runs without parameters (pg simple protocol allows several statements), can chain `; UPDATE ...` / `; DROP ...`. Bind the term as a parameter, as `query` in src/db.ts is documented to require ("values go in `params`, never in `sql`"): `query<UserRow>("SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE name LIKE $1 ESCAPE '\\' ORDER BY name LIMIT 50", ['%' + term.replace(/[\\%_]/g, '\\$&') + '%'])`, escaping `%`, `_` and `\` so the term is matched literally as the proposal's "name contains the term" requires. Add a test sending a quote in `q`.
findings.title: SQL injection through the search term
